dn30:1.1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
dn30:1.1.7: ‘Dvattiṃs' imāni bhikkhave MahāPurisassa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa MahāPurisassa dve gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
dn30:1.1.8: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapada-tthāvariya-ppatto satta-ratana-samannāgato.
dn30:1.1.10: seyyathīdaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthi-ratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyaka-ratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn30:1.1.11: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa putta bhavanti sūrā vīraṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā.
dn30:1.1.12: So imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn30:1.1.13: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati arahaṃ hoti Sammā-Sambuddho loke vivatta-cchaddo. 2.
dn30:1.2.1: ‘Katamāni ca tāni bhikkhave MahāPurisassa dvattiṃsa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa MahāPurisassa dve gatiyo honti anaññā?
dn30:1.2.2: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe. . . .
dn30:1.2.3: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti SammāSambuddho loke vivatta-cchaddo.
dn30:1.2.4: ‘Idha bhikkhave MahāPuriso suppatiṭṭhita-pādo hoti. Yam pi bhikkhave MahāPuriso suppatiṭṭhita-pādo hoti, idam pi bhikkhave MahāPurisassa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn30:1.2.5: ‘Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave MahāPurisassa heṭṭhā pāda-talesu cakkāni jātāni honti sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāra-paripūrāni suvibhattantarāni . Yam pi bhikkhave MahāPurisassa . . . pe . . . idam pi bhikkhave MahāPurisassa MahāPurisa -lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn30:1.2.6: ‘Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave MahāPuriso āyata-paṇhī hoti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.2.12: pe . . . ‘ Ṭhitako va anonamanto ubhohi pāṇi-talehi jannukāni parimasati parimajjati . . .
dn30:1.2.15: ‘Sukhuma-cchavī hoti sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalippati . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.2.17: pe . . . ‘Uddhagga-lomo hoti, uddhaggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjana-vaṇṇāni kuṇḍala-vattāni padakkhiṇāvattakajātāni . . . pe . . . ‘ Brahmujju
dn30:1.2.26: yāvatakv assa kāyo tāvatakv assa vyāmo, yāvatakv assa vyāmo tāvatakv assa kāyo . . . pe . . . ‘Samavatta-kkhandho hoti . . .
dn30:1.2.33: pe . . . ‘Pahūta-jivho hoti . . . pe . . . ‘Brahma-ssaro hoti . . . pe . . . ‘Karavīka-bhāṇī hoti . . . pe . . . ‘Abhinīla-netto hoti . . . pe . . . ‘Go-pakhumo hoti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.2.34: ‘Uṇṇā bhamuk-antare jātā hoti odātā mudu-tūlasannibhā. Yam pi bhikkhave MahāPurisassa uṇṇā bhamuk-antare jātā hoti odātā mudu-tūla-sannibhā, idam pi bhikkhave MahāPurisassa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn30:1.2.35: ‘Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave MahāPuriso uṇhīsa-sīso hoti. Yam pi bhikkhave MahāPuriso uṇhīsa-sīso hoti, idam pi bhikkhave MahāPurisassa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati. 3.
dn30:1.3.1: ‘Imāni kho tāni bhikkhave dvattiṃsa MahāPurisassa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni yehi samannāgatassa MahāPurisassa dve gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
dn30:1.3.2: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti dhammiko dhammarāja cāturanto vijitāvī janapada-tthāvariya-ppatto sattaratana-samannāgato. Tass' imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti: seyyathīdaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthi-ratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyaka ratanam eva sattamaṃ. Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr-aṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā. So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn30:1.3.3: Sace kho panāgārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti SammāSambuddho loke vivatta-cchaddo.
dn30:1.3.4: Imāni kho te bhikkhave MahāPurisassa dvattiṃsa MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni bāhirakā pi isayo dhārenti, no ca kho te jānanti
dn30:1.4.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno daḷha-samādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu avatthita-samādāno, kāya-sucarite vacī-sucarite manosucarite, dāna-saṃvibhāge sīla-samādāne uposathūpavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brāhmaññatāya kule jeṭṭhāpacāyitāya aññataraññataresu ca adhikusalesu dhammesu:
dn30:1.4.2: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati.
dn30:1.4.3: So tattha aññe deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti, dibbena āyunā dibbena vaṇṇena dibbena sukhena dibbena yasena dibbena adhipateyyena dibbehi rūpehi dibbehi saddehi dibbehi gandhehi dibbehi rasehi dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi.
dn30:1.4.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.4.6: samaṃ pādaṃ bhūmiyaṃ nikkhipati, samaṃ uddharati, samaṃ sabbāvantehi pāda-talehi bhūmiṃ phusati. 5.
dn30:1.5.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapada-tthāvariya-ppatto satta-ratanasamannāgato.
dn30:1.5.3: seyyathīdaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthi-ratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn30:1.5.4: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr-aṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā.
dn30:1.5.5: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ akhilam animittam akaṇṭakaṃ iddhaṃ phītaṃ khemaṃ sivaṃ nirabbudaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn30:1.5.7: Avikkhambhiyo hoti kenaci manussa-bhūtena paccatthikena pacāmittena.
dn30:1.5.9: Sace kho panāgārasmā anāgāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti Sammā-Sambuddho loke vivattacchaddo.
dn30:1.5.11: Avikkhambhiyo hoti abbhantarehi vā bāhirakehi vā paccatthikehi vā paccāmittehi rāgena vā dosena vā mohena vā Samaṇena vā Brāhmaṇena vā Devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
dn30:1.6.2: Sacce ca dhamme ca dame ca saṃyame
dn30:1.6.20: Aggo na so gacchati jātu gabbhaṃ
dn30:1.6.21: nar-uttamo, esa hi tassa dhammatā ti.' 7.
dn30:1.7.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.7.2: bahujana-sukhāya ahosi, ubbegaṃ uttāsaṃ bhayaṃ apanuditā dhammikañ ca rakkhāvaraṇa-guttiṃ saṃvidhātā saparivārañ ca dānaṃ adāsi,
dn30:1.7.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.7.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisalakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati.
dn30:1.7.5: Heṭṭhā pāda-talesu cakkāni jātāni honti sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni suvibhattantarāni. 8.
dn30:1.8.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkhavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.8.4: mahā 'ssa hoti parivāro brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negama-jānapadā gaṇakamahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:1.8.6: Sace pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti Sammā-Sambuddho loke vivatta-cchaddo.
dn30:1.8.9: mahā 'ssa hoti parivāro bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:1.10.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.10.2: pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato ahosi, nihita-daṇḍo nihita-sattho lajjī dayāpanno sabba-pāṇabhūta-hitānukampī vihāsi,
dn30:1.10.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.10.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni tīni MahāPurisalakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.10.5: āyata-paṇhī ca hoti dīgh-aṅgulī ca Brahmujju-gatto ca. 11.
dn30:1.11.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.11.3: Dīghāyuko hoti ciraṭṭhitiko, dīgham āyum pāleti, na sakkā hoti antarā jīvitā voropetuṃ kenaci manussa-bhūtena paccatthikena paccāmittena.
dn30:1.11.6: Dīghāyuko hoti ciraṭṭhitiko, dīgham āyum pāleti, na sakkā hoti antarā jīvitā voropetuṃ paccatthikehi paccāmittehi Samaṇena vā Brāhmaṇena vā Devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
dn30:1.12.9: pāṇiko Brahmā viy' ujju subho sujāta-gatto,
dn30:1.13.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.13.2: dātā ahosi paṇītānaṃ rasitānaṃ khādanīyānaṃ bhojanīyānaṃ sāyanīyānaṃ lehanīyānaṃ pānānaṃ,
dn30:1.13.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.13.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati, sattussado hoti. Satt' ussadā honti,
dn30:1.13.5: ubhosu hatthesu ussadā honti, ubhosu pādesu ussadā honti, ubhosu aṃsa kūṭesu ussadā honti, khandhe ussado hoti. 14.
dn30:1.14.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato sace agāram ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.14.3: Lābhī hoti paṇītānaṃ rasitānaṃ khādanīyānaṃ bhojanīyānaṃ sāyanīyānaṃ lehanīyānaṃ pānānaṃ.
dn30:1.14.6: Lābhī hoti paṇītānaṃ rasitānaṃ khādanīyānaṃ bhojanīyānaṃ sāyanīyānaṃ lehanīyānaṃ pānānaṃ.
dn30:1.15.8: Āhu vyañjana-nimitta-kovidā khajja-bhojja-rasa-lābhitāya. Na taṃ gihissa
dn30:1.15.9: pi tadattha-jotakaṃ, pabbajjam pi tad adhigacchati, Khajja-bhojja-rasa- lābhī-r-uttamaṃ āhu sabba-gihi-bandhana-cchidan ti. 16.
dn30:1.16.1: bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.16.4: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipullattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn30:1.16.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.17.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.17.3: Susaṅgahita-parijano hoti, susaṅgahitā 'ssa honti brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negama-jānapadā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:1.17.6: Susaṅgahitaparijano hoti, susaṅgahitā 'ssa honti bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:1.18.2: Dānam pi ca attha-cariyatam pi ca piya-vadatañ ca samāna-
dn30:1.19.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno bahuno janassa
dn30:1.19.2: atthūpasaṃhitaṃ dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosi, bahujanaṃ nidaṃseti, pāṇīnaṃ hita-sukhāvaho ahu dhamma-yāgī,
dn30:1.19.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.19.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.20.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.20.3: Aggo ca hoti seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca kāma-bhogīnaṃ.
dn30:1.20.6: Aggo ca hoti seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca sabba-sattānaṃ.
dn30:1.21.8: Lakkhaṇāni ca dve idh' āgato uttama-
dn30:1.21.14: sādhu saṇṭhitā, Maṃsa-lohitācitā tacotatā upari 17ca pana sobhanā 18 ahu. Geham āvasati ce tathā-vidho
dn30:1.22.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.22.2: sakkaccaṃ vācetā ahosi sippaṃ vā vijjaṃ vā caraṇaṃ vā kammaṃ vā,
dn30:1.22.3: "Kinti me khippaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, khippaṃ vijāneyyuṃ, khippaṃ sampaṭipajjeyyuṃ, na ciraṃ kilisseyyun ti,"
dn30:1.22.4: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.22.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.23.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:1.23.3: Yāni etāni rājārahāni rāj-aṅgāni rājūpabhogāni rājānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati.
dn30:1.23.6: Yāni tāni samaṇārahāni samaṇaṅgāni samaṇūpabhogāni samaṇānucchavikāni, tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati.
dn30:1.25.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.25.2: Samaṇaṃ vā Brāhmaṇaṃ vā upasaṃkamitvā paripucchitā ahosi:
dn30:1.25.3: "Kiṃ bhante kusalaṃ, kiṃ akusalaṃ? Kiṃ sāvajjaṃ, kiṃ anavajjaṃ? Kiṃ sevitabbaṃ, kiṃ na sevitabbaṃ? Kim me kayiramānaṃ dīgha-rattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya assa? Kiṃ vā pana me kayiramānaṃ dīgha-rattaṃ hitāya sukhāya assāti?",
dn30:1.25.4: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.25.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno idaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.25.6: sukhuma-cchavī hoti, sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalippati. 26.
dn30:1.26.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:1.26.3: Mahā-pañño hoti, nāssa hoti koci paññāya sadiso vā visiṭṭho vā kāma-bhogīnaṃ.
dn30:1.26.6: Mahā-pañño hoti puthu-pañño hāsu-pañño javana-pañño tikkha-pañño nibbedhika-pañño, nāssa hoti koci paññāya sadiso vā visiṭṭho vā sabba-sattānaṃ.
dn30:1.27.13: na tena seyyo sadiso va vijjati.
dn30:1.28.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.28.3: bahum pi vutto samāno nābhisajji na kuppi na vyāpajji na patiṭṭhayi, na kopañ ca dosañ ca appaccayañ ca pātvākāsi,
dn30:1.28.4: dātā ca ahosi sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāpuraṇānaṃ khoma-sukhumānaṃ kappāsika-sukhumānaṃ koseyyasukhumānaṃ kambala-sukhumānaṃ,
dn30:1.28.6: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.29.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:1.29.3: Lābhī hoti sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāpuraṇānaṃ khoma-sukhumānaṃ kappāsika-sukhumānaṃ koseyya-sukhumānaṃ kambala- sukhumānaṃ .
dn30:1.29.6: Lābhī hoti sukhumānaṃ mudukānaṃ attharaṇānaṃ pāpuraṇānaṃ khoma-sukhumānam kappāsikasukhumānaṃ koseyya-sukhumānaṃ kambala-sukhumānaṃ.
dn30:1.30.3: ca dānaṃ vatthāni ca sukhumāni succhavīni.
dn30:1.30.13: paṭilabhati vipulaṃ sukhumañ ca succhaviñ ca.
dn30:1.31.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:1.31.2: cira-ppanaṭṭhe sucira-ppavāsino ñāti-mitte suhajje sakhino samānetā ahosi,
dn30:1.31.3: mātaram pi puttena samānetā ahosi, puttam pi mātarā samānetā ahosi, pitaram pi puttena samānetā ahosi, puttam pi pitarā samānetā ahosi, bhātaram pi bhātarā samānetā ahosi, bhātaram pi bhaginiyā samānetā ahosi, bhaginim pi bhātarā samānetā ahosi, samaggiṃ katvā ca abbhanumoditā ahosi,
dn30:1.31.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:1.32.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato sace agāram ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:1.32.3: Pahūta-putto hoti, paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr-aṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā.
dn30:1.32.6: Pahūta-putto hoti, aneka-sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti, sūrā vīr-aṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā.
dn30:2.1.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.1.2: mahājana-saṅgahaṃ samekkhamāno saṃjānāti, sāmaṃ jānāti, purisam jānāti, purisa-visesaṃ jānāti: "
dn30:2.1.3: Ayam idam arahati, ayam idam arahatīti," tattha tattha purisa-visesa-karo ahosi,
dn30:2.1.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.1.6: nigrodhaparimaṇḍalo ca hoti ṭhitako ca anonamanto ubhohi pāṇi-talehi jannukāni parimasati parimajjati. 2.
dn30:2.2.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.2.3: Aḍḍho hoti mahaddhano mahā-bhogo pahūtajātarūpa-rajato pahūta-vittupakaraṇo pahūta-dhanadhañño paripuṇṇako sakoṭṭhāgāro.
dn30:2.2.8: saddhā-dhanaṃ sīla-dhanaṃ hiridhanaṃ ottappa-dhanaṃ suta-dhanaṃ cāga-dhanaṃ paññā-dhanaṃ.
dn30:2.3.6: Sa hi ca pana ṭhito anonamanto
dn30:2.4.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.4.2: bahuno janassa attha-kāmo ahosi hita-kāmo phāsu-kāmo yogakkhema-kāmo --
dn30:2.4.3: "kinti 'me saddhāya vaḍḍheyyuṃ, sīlena vaḍḍheyyum, sutena vaḍḍheyyuṃ, cāgena vaḍḍheyyuṃ, dhammena vaḍḍheyyuṃ, paññāya vaḍḍheyyuṃ, dhana-dhaññena vaḍḍheyyuṃ, khetta-vatthunā vaḍḍheyyuṃ, dipada-catuppadehi vaḍḍheyyuṃ, putta-dārehi vaḍḍheyyuṃ, dāsa-kammakara -porisehi vaḍḍheyyuṃ, ñātīhi vaḍḍheyyuṃ, mittehi vaḍḍheyyuṃ, bandhavehi vaḍḍheyyun ti," --
dn30:2.4.4: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.4.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni tīṇi MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.4.6: sīha-pubbaddha-kāyo ca hoti citantaraṃso ca samavatta-kkhando ca. 5.
dn30:2.5.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.5.3: Aparihāna-dhammo hoti, na parihāyati dhana-dhaññena khetta-vatthunā dipada-catuppadehi putta-dārehi dāsakammakara-porisehi ñāti-mittehi bandhavehi, na parihāyati sabba-sampattiyā.
dn30:2.5.6: Aparihāna-dhammo hoti, na parihāyati saddhāya sīlena sutena cāgena paññāya, na parihāyati sabba-sampattiyā.
dn30:2.7.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe-manussa-bhūto samāno,
dn30:2.7.2: sattānaṃ aviheṭhaka-jātiko ahosi pāṇinā vā leḍḍunā vā daṇḍena vā satthena vā,
dn30:2.7.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.7.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisalakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati, rasaggas-aggī hoti, uddhaggassa rasa-haraṇiyo gīvāya jātā honti samabhivāhiniyo. 8.
dn30:2.8.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.8.3: Appābādho hoti appātaṅko sama-vepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya.
dn30:2.8.6: Appābādho hoti appātaṅko sama-vepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhāna-kkhamāya.
dn30:2.9.2: Na pāṇinā na ca pana daṇḍa-leḍḍunā
dn30:2.9.6: Ten' eva so sugatim upecca modati
dn30:2.10.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato . . . pe . . . pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.10.2: na visaṭam na ca visācitaṃ na pana viceyya-pekkhitā uju tathā pasaṭam udu-mano piya-cakkhunā bahujanaṃ udikkhitā ahosi,
dn30:2.10.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.10.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.11.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato, sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.11.3: Piya-dassano hoti bahuno janassa, piyo hoti manāpo brāhmaṇa-gahapatikānaṃ negama-jānapadānaṃ gaṇaka-mahāmattānaṃ anīkaṭṭha-dovārikānaṃ amaccānaṃ pārisajjānaṃ rājūnaṃ bhogiyānaṃ kumārānaṃ.
dn30:2.11.6: Piya-dassano hoti bahuno janassa, piyo hoti manāpo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakanaṃ upāsikānaṃ devānaṃ manussānaṃ asurānaṃ nāgānaṃ gandhabbānaṃ.
dn30:2.12.2: Na ca visaṭaṃ na ca visācitaṃ
dn30:2.12.16: Yadi ca na bhavati gihī Samaṇo hoti
dn30:2.13.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato . . . pe . . . pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.13.2: bahujana-pubbaṅgamo ahosi kusalesu dhammesu bahujana-pāmokkho kāya-sucarite vacīsucarite mano-sucarite dāna-saṃvibhāge sīla-samādāne uposathūpavāse metteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kule-jeṭṭhāpacāyitāya aññatar-aññataresu adhikusalesu dhammesu,
dn30:2.13.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.13.4: So tato cute itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.14.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.14.3: Mahā 'ssa jano anvāyiko hoti, brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negama-jānapadā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:2.14.6: Mahā 'ssa jano anvāyiko hoti bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:2.15.14: Atha ce pi pabbajati so manujo
dn30:2.16.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato . . . pe . . . pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.16.2: musā-vādaṃ pahāya musā-vādā paṭivirato ahosi sacca-vādī sacca-sandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa,
dn30:2.16.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.16.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.16.5: ekeka-lomo ca hoti uṇṇā ca bhamuk-antare jātā hoti odātā mudutūla-sannibhā. 17.
dn30:2.17.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato sace āgāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.17.3: Mahā 'ssa jano upavattati brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negamajānapadā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:2.17.6: Mahā 'ssa jano upavattati bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:2.18.17: Buddham pi santaṃ upavattati jano ti.' 19.
dn30:2.19.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ . . . pe . . . pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.19.2: pisuṇā -vācam pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosi, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesam bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na-y-imesaṃ akkhātā amūsam bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppādātā samaggārāmo samagga-rato samagga-nandī samagga-karaṇiṃ vācam bhāsitā ahosi,
dn30:2.19.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati. . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.19.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.20.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.20.3: Abhejja-pariso hoti abhejjā 'ssa honti brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negama-jānapadā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:2.20.6: Abhejja-pariso hoti abhejjā 'ssa honti bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:2.22.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave . . . pe . . . pubbe manussabhūto samāno
dn30:2.22.2: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosi, yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇa-sukhā pemanīyā hadayaṃ-gamā porī bahujana-kantā bahujana-manāpā, tathā-rūpaṃ vācaṃ bhasitā ahosi,
dn30:2.22.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.22.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa- lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.22.5: pahūta jivho ca hoti brahmassaro ca karavīka- bhāṇī . 23.
dn30:2.23.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.23.3: Ādeyya-vāco hoti, ādiyanti 'ssa vacanaṃ brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negama-jānapadā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:2.23.6: Ādeyya-vāco hoti, ādiyanti 'ssa vacanaṃ bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:2.24.7: vācā. So erayati kaṇṇa-sukhā, Vācā suciṇṇa-phalam
dn30:2.24.15: atha ce pi pabbajati so manujo,
dn30:2.25.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.25.2: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato ahosi, kāla-vādī bhūta-vādī attha-vādī dhamma-vādī vinaya-vādī nidhāna-vatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosi kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ attha-saṃhitaṃ,
dn30:2.25.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā ussannattā vipulattā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjati . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.25.4: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imaṃ MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ paṭilabhati,
dn30:2.26.1: ‘So tena lakkhaṇena samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti.
dn30:2.26.3: Appadhaṃsiko hoti kenaci manussa-bhūtena paccattatthikena paccāmittena.
dn30:2.26.6: Appadhaṃsiko hoti abbhantarehi vā bāhirehi vā paccatthikehi paccāmittehi rāgena vā dosena vā mohena vā Samaṇena vā Brāhmaṇena vā Devena vā Mārena vā Brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
dn30:2.27.5: hitam pi ca bahujana-sukhañ ca abhaṇi .
dn30:2.27.6: Taṃ katvāna ito cuto dibbaṃ upapajji, sukata-
dn30:2.27.17: idha disā ca paṭidisā ca vidisā cāti.' 28.
dn30:2.28.1: ‘Yam pi bhikkhave Tathāgato purimaṃ jātiṃ purimaṃ bhavaṃ purimaṃ niketaṃ pubbe manussa-bhūto samāno
dn30:2.28.2: micchājīvam pahāya sammā-ājīvena jīvikaṃ kappesi tulākūṭa-kaṃsakūṭa-mānakūṭa-ukkoṭana-vañcana-nikati-sāci-yogā chedana-vadha-bandhana-viparāmosa-ālopa-sāhasākārā paṭivirato ahosi,
dn30:2.28.3: so tassa kammassa katattā upacitattā . . . pe . . .
dn30:2.28.5: So tato cuto itthattaṃ āgato samāno imāni dve MahāPurisa-lakkhaṇāni paṭilabhati, sama-danto ca hoti susukka-dāṭho ca. 29.
dn30:2.29.1: ‘So tehi lakkhaṇehi samannāgato sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati Rājā hoti Cakkavatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapada-tthāvariya-ppatto satta-ratanasamannāgato.
dn30:2.29.2: Tass' imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyathīdaṃ
dn30:2.29.3: cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi -ratanaṃ itthi-ratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn30:2.29.4: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr-aṅga-rūpā parasena-ppamaddanā.
dn30:2.29.5: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ akhilam animittam akaṇṭakam iddhaṃ phītaṃ khemaṃ sivaṃ nirabbudaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn30:2.29.7: Suci-parivāro hoti, suci 'ssa honti parivārā brāhmaṇa-gahapatikā negama-jānapadā gaṇaka-mahāmattā anīkaṭṭhā dovārikā amaccā pārisajjā rājāno bhogiyā kumārā.
dn30:2.30.1: ‘Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti Sammā-Sambuddho loke vivatta-cchaddo.
dn30:2.30.3: Suci-parivāro hoti, suci 'ssa honti parivārā bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā.
dn30:2.31.5: hitam pi ca bahujana-sukhañ ca ācari.
dn30:2.31.25: pi ca param pi ca passati lokaṃ.
dn30:2.31.26: Tass' ovāda-karā bahu-gihī ca pabbajitā ca
